title: Musa, Part 10: Three Strange Acts
fact_notes: Line 6 (18:74) kept short and non-graphic per rule 3; the boy is never drawn, shown only by a small ball left on the sand under a dimmed sky.
The servant of Allah is shown only as the green cloak (as in Part 9). The name Khidr (Sahih al-Bukhari 122) is not spoken in this part.

lines.text: Three times, Musa saw him do something that made no sense.
lines.spoken: Three times, Musa saw him do something that made no sense.

lines.text: They boarded a ship, and the man tore a hole in it.
lines.spoken: They boarded a ship, and the man tore a hole in it.

lines.text: Musa said: "Did you tear it to drown its people? A grave thing!"
lines.spoken: Musa said: "Did you tear it to drown its people? A grave thing!"

lines.text: He said: "Did I not say you would never have patience with me?"
lines.spoken: He said: "Did I not say you would never have patience with me?"

lines.text: "Do not blame me for what I forgot," said Musa.
lines.spoken: "Do not blame me for what I forgot," said Musa.

lines.text: Then they met a boy, and the man took his life.
lines.spoken: Then they met a boy, and the man took his life.

lines.text: Musa cried: "A pure soul, who took no life? This is terrible!"
lines.spoken: Musa cried: "A pure soul, who took no life? This is terrible!"

lines.text: "Did I not tell you, you would never have patience?"
lines.spoken: "Did I not tell you, you would never have patience?"

lines.text: "If I ask again," said Musa, "do not keep me with you."
lines.spoken: "If I ask again," said Musa, "do not keep me with you."

lines.text: In a town that refused them food, the man rebuilt a falling wall.
lines.spoken: In a town that refused them food, the man rebuilt a falling wall.

lines.text: Musa said: "You could have taken payment for it."
lines.spoken: Musa said: "You could have taken payment for it."

lines.text: He said: "This is where we part. Now I will tell you why."
lines.spoken: He said: "This is where we part. Now I will tell you why."

lines.text: What wisdom was hidden behind all three? Follow for Part 11.
lines.spoken: What wisdom was hidden behind all three? Follow for Part eleven.
